description: Introduction to snapWONDERS Vaultify steganography: what it does, how its AES-256 + Argon2id encryption protects hidden files, a pre-computed sample hide result showing the exact response schema, and guidance on creating a free account and API key to start using the API. No API key required. Gives an overview of the whole Vaultify workflow.
name: vaultify_get_started
